# Docks Overseas

> Fresh fruit and vegetable exporter based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> Sources at the farm gate, grades and packs to buyer specification, and ships
> under an unbroken cold chain to the Gulf, Europe and beyond. Run by three
> directors; a buyer deals with an owner rather than a sales desk.

Docks Overseas is a partnership of Darshan KS, Sai Harsha Anne and Rachana HM.
It exports five core produce lines and sources others to order. Trial
quantities of a single container or air consignment are normal for new buyers.
Quotes are given on EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF or DAP.

## Produce lines

- [Pomegranate](https://www.docksoverseas.com/pomegranate.html): Bhagwa and
  Ganesh. Season September–February. 200–500 g, 3.5/4 kg cartons, 5–7 °C reefer.
- [Green and red chilli](https://www.docksoverseas.com/chilli.html): long green,
  bullet, Byadgi red, Jwala. Year round. 5/10 kg ventilated cartons, 8–10 °C,
  air freight or reefer.
- [Husked coconut](https://www.docksoverseas.com/husked-coconut.html): semi and
  fully husked. Year round. 350 g–700 g+, mesh or 20 kg cartons, 22–25 MT per
  40 ft dry container.
- [Cavendish banana](https://www.docksoverseas.com/banana.html): G9 export
  grade, 39–43 calliper. Year round. 13 kg cartons, shipped green at 13–14 °C.
- [Suran / elephant foot yam](https://www.docksoverseas.com/suran.html): cured,
  October–March. 0.8–3 kg+, 10/20 kg packs, 6–8 week shelf life.

Beyond these, onion, ginger, drumstick, okra and curry leaf are sourced to
order.

## Notes

- Specification figures on the produce pages are indicative. Season windows
  shift with weather, and packing is adjusted to a buyer's market.
- Pricing is quoted per enquiry rather than published, as is normal in fresh
  produce where the market moves weekly.
